scope.summary: Analyzes Power Automate Process Mining processes, bottlenecks, variants, cohorts, and object-centric executions through a bundled local MCP server. Upstream states the plugin does not create views, visualizations, saved metrics, or business rules.

bundledScripts.purpose: Pre-bundled Process Intelligence MCP server launched over stdio by the plugin's .mcp.json.

externalNetworkCalls: Power Automate Process Mining service endpoints (process, metric, and object-centric queries)

servers.name: process-intelligence
servers.purpose: Exposes Process Mining analysis tools to the agent.

dependencies.name: Power Automate Process Mining
dependencies.description: Analysis depends on processes and features enabled in the connected Process Mining service.

dependencies.name: Azure CLI (az) sign-in
dependencies.description: The bundled MCP server authenticates through the Azure CLI.

dependencies.name: Node.js 22 or later
dependencies.description: The bundled MCP server and its build require Node.js 22 or 24.
